seed_selection: Two distinct 32-bit values drawn before any new games with the system random source; prepare rejects values found in the documented metadata inventory.
budget: Eight official complete games, each with primary replay, plus one fixed independent replay; at most 12223 official transitions, no retries.
criteria: Against the fixed round2 opponent, for each seed require two-seat mean own-profit and margin change at least -1000, and each seat at least -2000; two seeds are an exploratory screen, not significance or automatic promotion.
boundaries: No training, model or strategy change; preserve prior failed panel, consumed seeds, default Bot and all historical evidence; stop on failed or uncertain game or replay.
